# New-item calendar fallback sorts usable candidates before selecting the first

For a new item with an unusable selected calendar, the dialog first checks whether usable candidates remain. It orders them with sortCalendarArray before selecting index 0 and updating calendarItem.calendar. That helper follows calendar.list.sortOrder and can repair the preference when given all calendars. The added test directly checks both the usable selected-calendar case and the reordered fallback case; it was not executed here.

Scope: Calendar item dialog calendar selection.
